video_title: Shams Charania BREAKS NEWS on Tyrese Haliburton’s injury status 😳 | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton sidelined with a strained left hamstring
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Haliburton has a strained left hamstring, he's going to miss some time.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Haliburton has a strained left hamstring, he's going to miss some time. The Pacers doctors and Haliburton are all trying to figure out exactly how long that's going to be. He's expected to be out tonight against the Sixers. Anytime you have a hamstring injury, especially coming off the Achilles last year and all the ramp up that goes into it, this is typically measured in a week, weeks. They're going to figure out exactly how long that's going to be.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards to undergo arthroscopic knee procedure
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards will undergo an arthroscopic procedure on his ailing right knee.
quotes.quote: Minnesota Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards will undergo an arthroscopic procedure on his ailing right knee and miss up to two months. He's been dealing with knee issues in that right knee since last year, swelling, things of that sort. They've had to get multiple images every few weeks to make sure everything is on point. Well, he's been laboring through it the last week or so ever since the season started. They got a new series of tests this week that showed further damage that had to get cleaned up.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Dallas Mavericks monitoring Kyrie Irving's trade availability
quotes.excerpt: There's a slew of teams now that are monitoring Kyrie Irving.
quotes.quote: There's a slew of teams now that are monitoring Kyrie Irving. He's in the last year of his deal, he's got a player option next year. And so if you're a contending team and if the Mavericks are not really contending come trade deadline, do they look to trade him potentially to a contender for draft picks? That is what's also at the forefront of other teams' minds.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and Knicks dealing with championship hangover
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson and the players have admitted that there is some championship hangover.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson and the players have admitted that there is some championship hangover. They've admitted that they're kind of feeling the champagne still in their veins. How do you figure out getting that edge back, getting the motivation back? And I think that's going to be important for this team. They started the season with a disconnect from James Dolan, the front office, and the players because Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart wanted contract extensions.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks table contract extension talks with Brunson and Hart
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks come out with a statement and say, we're not having any extension talks.
quotes.quote: The Knicks come out with a statement and say, we're not having any extension talks with you guys. We're going to table this till the end of the season. Well, that is a sign to the players that as much as you guys want to extend, we're not going to talk extension. But at the end of the day, the Knicks know this and the players know this, the focus being on the court. This team still has a chance to win a championship this year.
